signals.title: Diamond share up +1.1pp → 41.8%
signals.detail: 392,670,052 SPX now in the longest-held tier.
signals.framing: Post it — ~9,976,658 SPX just aged into DIAMOND hands (the longest-held, rarely-sold tier). Coins reach it only by being HELD through everything, not by trading — supply maturing into strong hands, conviction deepening. Diamond hands earning the name.
signals.note: Word it as HELD, not BOUGHT: the +9,976,658 came from a cohort aging in from gold (≈ gold -10,924,456), not fresh demand. "Held into diamond" ✓ · "diamonds bought 9,976,658" ✗.

signals.title: Holders ~14% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.86: price is 14% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.499). Yet 58% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has slipped 1.08→0.86 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

signals.title: -81% below its all-time high
signals.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -92%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
signals.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
signals.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.
